# v1.3.0 — CLI header redesign (three-line project info box)

> **zread-pi 1.3.0**: the TUI's top project info box shrinks from 7 lines to 3 —
> "project identity, model / thinking level / blueprint level, docs status" at a glance,
> and for the first time the header directly shows the **multi-detail coexistence** overview (article count per level).

## ✨ New capabilities

| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| **Three-line header** | Line 1: project name + version + directory (`~` abbreviated); line 2: model (provider/model) + thinking level + blueprint level (write target, always shown); line 3: docs status (not generated / generated + per-level variant list) |
| **Header variant list** | When docs exist, all variants are listed as `[level - N articles]` (active level first, legacy directory shown as "Default"); a `target: <level>` hint is appended only when the write-target level has not been generated yet |
| **Blueprint level always visible** | `blueprint.detail` (the write target) stays on line 2, consistent with the target of generate / continue / sync — no need to open the config page to confirm |

## 🔧 Behavior differences (intentional)

- The header drops the provider line, base-URL line, and blank line; the base URL is credential/endpoint detail, now only in the provider detail page.
- The header adds nothing related to `Ls`; the line-3 variant list only counts variants with `pagesCount > 0` (a skeleton doesn't count as generated).
- Four i18n keys removed: `layout.provider` / `layout.baseUrl` / `layout.thinking` / `layout.directory` (`layout.model` kept, still used by the config-thinking view); six new `layout.docs*` keys, both language dictionaries updated in sync.

## 📦 Install

```bash
# Option 1: standalone binary (zip attached to this release, unzip and run)
#   zread-pi-v1.3.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# Option 2: from source
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli --dir <target-repo>
```

## ✅ Verification

- `bun run typecheck`: 0 errors
- `bun run test:tui`: 226 + 9 + 10 + 36 + 28 + 42 + 50 all passing (including updated header assertions and the mock end-to-end run)

# v1.3.0 —— CLI 头部重设计（三行项目信息框）

> **zread-pi 1.3.0**：TUI 顶部项目信息框从 7 行压缩为 3 行——
> 一屏看清「项目身份、模型/思考深度/蓝图档位、文档状态」，
> 并首次在头部直接展示**多档位共存**的产物概况（各档位篇数一目了然）。

## ✨ 新能力

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **三行头部** | 第 1 行：项目名 + 版本 + 目录（`~` 缩写）；第 2 行：模型（provider/model）+ 思考深度 + 蓝图档位（写盘目标，恒显）；第 3 行：文档状态（未生成 / 已生成 + 各档位变体列表） |
| **头部变体列表** | 已生成文档时按 `[档位 - N 篇]` 列出所有变体（活动档位在前，遗留目录显示为「默认」）；仅当写盘目标档位尚未生成时附加 `目标: <档位>` 提示 |
| **蓝图档位恒显** | `blueprint.detail`（写盘目标）常驻第 2 行，与生成 / 继续 / 同步的作用目标一致，不再需要进配置页确认 |

## 🔧 行为差异（有意为之）

- 头部移除 Provider 行、Base URL 行与空行；Base URL 属于凭据/端点细节，统一在 Provider 详情页查看。
- 头部新增 `Ls` 无关；第 3 行变体列表只统计 `pagesCount > 0` 的变体（骨架不算已生成）。
- `layout.provider` / `layout.baseUrl` / `layout.thinking` / `layout.directory` 四个 i18n key 已删除（`layout.model` 保留，config-thinking 视图仍在用）；新增 `layout.docs*` 六个 key，两份语言字典同步。

## 📦 安装

```bash
# 方式一：standalone 二进制（本 Release 附带的 zip，解压即用）
#   zread-pi-v1.3.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# 方式二：从源码运行
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli --dir <目标仓库>
```

## ✅ 验证

- `bun run typecheck`：0 错误
- `bun run test:tui`：226 + 9 + 10 + 36 + 28 + 42 + 50 全部通过（含头部断言更新与 mock 全链路）
